about: Curated events for Bitblocks.Annotations.seed/0. Each has a source; seed adds only what isn't there (kind + title). Edit them at /annotations afterwards.

annotations.title: Bitcoin whitepaper published
annotations.body: Satoshi Nakamoto posts "Bitcoin: A Peer-to-Peer Electronic Cash System" to the cryptography mailing list. Before the genesis block, so it stays off the chain.

annotations.title: Genesis block
annotations.body: Its coinbase carries The Times headline of 3 January 2009: "Chancellor on brink of second bailout for banks". Its 50-coin output can never be spent.

annotations.title: First spend: Satoshi sends 10 coins to Hal Finney
annotations.body: The first transaction that is not a coinbase. It spends the coinbase of block 9.

annotations.title: Bitcoin Pizza Day
annotations.body: Laszlo Hanyecz pays 10,000 coins for two pizzas, the first widely known purchase of goods.

annotations.title: Value overflow incident
annotations.body: A transaction creates 184 billion coins through an integer overflow. A patched client and a new chain replace the block within hours.

annotations.title: March 2013 chain fork (BIP 50)
annotations.body: Version 0.8 nodes accept a block that 0.7 nodes reject, and the chain splits for a few hours until miners return to the 0.7 side.

annotations.title: Bitcoin Cash splits from BTC
annotations.body: The first Bitcoin Cash block, after the last block the two chains share (478,558). This chain follows Bitcoin Cash.

annotations.title: Bitcoin SV splits from Bitcoin Cash
annotations.body: The hash war of November 2018 divides Bitcoin Cash into BSV and ABC. This chain follows BSV.

annotations.title: Genesis upgrade
annotations.body: BSV restores the original protocol: the default block size cap is lifted and most script limits are removed.
